audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Yorick/Skill/Mordekaiser/Mordekaiser/Mordekaiser/Mordekaiser/Mordekaiser against a packet levelChart of Skill/Mordekaiser/Mordekaiser/Mordekaiser/Mordekaiser/Skill/Yorick. The content captions agree with the packet: whys[5] calls the first-item row 'a genuine coin-flip window' while the chart gives it outright to Mordekaiser, and whys[6] opens 'He out-scales hard at 2+ items' while the chart gives that row to Mordekaiser too.
audit.why: 48.9% over 2272 games against an acknowledged hard scaler — the late rows cannot belong to Mordekaiser, and the page's own late prose says so explicitly ('this is where Yorick reclaims it and the 48.9% turns against you').

audit.whatIsWrong: Two verifiable mechanics are missing and one is described wrongly. (a) Dark Procession (W) is a DESTRUCTIBLE wall — Riot's text says 'summons a destructible wall'. The page treats being caged as an unanswerable event ('Traps you for the ghouls', 'Get caged') and never once tells the player he can simply break it. That is free counterplay the page withholds on the ability it names as matchup-defining. (b) Last Rites (Q) both HEALS him and is an auto-attack reset, on a 6s cooldown falling to 4s. There is no anti-heal advice anywhere on the page and report[8].t's item list has none. (c) breakdown.cooldowns lists Dark Procession twice as if it were two abilities and describes it as 'a ring of walls that traps enemies (or himself) inside', which does not match Riot's single-wall description.
audit.why: A destructible wall and a 4-second heal are the two things that decide whether the Mordekaiser trade pattern works, and neither reached the page.
audit.corrected: Rebuilt breakdown.cooldowns with Dark Procession's real 20s-to-12s cooldown plus the destructible property, and Eulogy of the Isles' 160s/100s. Put 'break the wall' into tldr, report[0].t, report[5].t, dosFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d, and the Last Rites heal + auto-reset into report[8].t and dontsFull[2].d, all of which previously carried filler that did not match their headings.
sources: enemyKit W text 'summons a destructible wall', cd 20/18/16/14/12
enemyKit Q text 'deals bonus damage on his next attack and heals himself', cd 6/5.5/5/4.5/4, heal + autoReset flags

notes: The content layer on this matchup is one of the two best in the slice — early already carries the correct correction that Mourning Mist is the slow-and-mark globule and NOT a wall, which is exactly the class of error the calibration list warns about. Everything wrong here lived in the full layer's templated fields. One thing I did not add: Mourning Mist also REDUCES ARMOUR per Riot's text. I left it out because Mordekaiser deals magic damage, so the armour shred is close to irrelevant to his side of the trade and adding it would have cost band space that the destructible wall used better. Flagging it here in case the Yorick-side mirror wants it.
